scope: Places depicted by Félix Benoist (1818–1896) and Philippe Benoist (1813–c.1905). G. P. Benoist, Antoine Benoist, Marie-Guillemine Benoist, J.-L. Benoist, François Benoist excluded.
identity_notes: Rome dans sa grandeur (Bibliotheca Hertziana): holder title names both Philippe and Félix Benoist; draughtsman of individual plates not specified -> artist recorded as both, identity_certainty "album-level only".

BnF records catalogued under "Benoist, Ph." (no dates) recorded as Philippe Benoist with identity_certainty "probable (initial only)"; BnF drawings bracketed "[Philippe Benoist ?]" keep the holder query in the title.
Moscow views "Benoist et Aubrun" (LoC: "lith par Benoist et Aubrun"; Commons): forename not given by holder -> Philippe Benoist, probable.
Commons "Benois Triumphal Gate 1848" (Moscow, Tverskaya Zastava) carries creator "Félix Benoist" on Commons; recorded as given, not verified against a holder record.
Album de l'Île de Jersey (Commons scans, uploader in creator field): attribution from album title "Dessins d'après nature par Félix Benoist" quoted in file descriptions.
Jersey Heritage records (creator "Benoist, Felix") are In Copyright (InC) for the digital image -> link only.
La Bretagne contemporaine: plates signed by Eugène Cicéri, F.-H. Lalaisse and others are NOT counted as Benoist works (Benoist was director of the publication); see excluded list.

albums_checked.La Bretagne contemporaine (1865–67): Commons category crawled (46 files); Félix Benoist-drawn plates found for Finistère, Côtes-du-Nord, Ille-et-Vilaine, Morbihan; no holder table of contents reachable (Gallica 403).
albums_checked.Nantes et la Loire-Inférieure (1850): Gallica volume records found via Europeana (bpt6k164488r, bpt6k1644894, bpt6k1644902) but no plate-level records; Loire-Inférieure château views on Commons are attributed to Félix Benoist without album statement.
albums_checked.Paris dans sa splendeur (1861): BnF plate records (via Europeana) + Commons/Paris Musées; Heidelberg PDM copy has text-chapter TOC only (no plate-level attribution).
albums_checked.Rome dans sa grandeur (1870): Hertziana plate records (40, In Copyright photo reproductions, link only) + 2 Commons files.
albums_checked.Album de Wilna: Only plates whose holder record names Philippe Benoist kept (university, St Anne); Album de Wilna plates by Sadovnikov/Bichebois/Deroy excluded.
albums_checked.Nice et Savoie (1864): Commons scans of the 3 parts (338 files) checked: creator fields name other artists (e.g. Joseph Dessaix) or none; only Saint-Étienne-de-Tinée (Commons) and Évian (BIU Santé) carry Félix Benoist as draughtsman. Plate list not verified.
albums_checked.Album de l'Île de Jersey: 20 Commons scans; places mapped from plate captions.
albums_checked.La Normandie illustrée (1852–54): Not verified: no record found that names the album; Félix Benoist Rouen plates of 1850/1852 (BnF) are recorded without assigning them to this album.
albums_checked.Voyages pittoresques (Taylor/Nodier): BnF Philippe Benoist drawings (Normandie, Picardie, Champagne, Brou) recorded; holder records do not state the Voyages pittoresques link, so no album assigned.

places_from_contents_note: No table of contents could be read (Gallica returns 403 to this container; Heidelberg TOC is text-only), so no contents-only places were added. Places with link-only works are listed in counts.places_with_no_open_image.
blockers: Wikimedia Commons API: repeated HTTP 429 (Retry-After honoured, max 3 tries); one imageinfo batch (incl. some Rijksmuseum/Vue officielle 1867 copies) and allcategories lookup "Normandie illustrée" recorded as blocked.
Wikidata SPARQL: 429 on first try, succeeded on retry; 30 places had no Wikidata coordinate via sitelink -> OSM Nominatim fallback.
Gallica (gallica.bnf.fr): HTTP 403 -> BnF data taken from Europeana records; BnF images (NoC-OKLR) kept link-only.
loc.gov/photos JSON returned 520; loc.gov/pictures JSON used.
